features.title: Sync transactions
features.user_visible_behavior: `syncTransactions(connectionId)` backfills from the oldest available date, then syncs incrementally from `last_synced_at` minus a 7-day overlap; it upserts on `provider_txn_ref` with `dedupe_hash` as fallback, replaces pending transactions with their booked version, removes stale pending ones, never overwrites manual category or note edits, follows pagination and records fetched / inserted / updated counts in `sync_runs`. Running it twice changes nothing.

features.title: Scheduled sync, Sync now and sync log
features.user_visible_behavior: The worker runs a `bank-sync` job on `SYNC_CRON` (default every 6 hours) for every active connection; a Postgres advisory lock prevents two syncs of one connection at once, and a failing connection is logged and retried on the next tick without stopping the others or crashing the worker. A Sync now button on the dashboard and `/connections` runs the same sync with a pending state, the first sync runs right after connecting, the connection page shows the last sync runs (status, duration, counts, errors) and the header shows the last successful sync.
